svg.text: One Postgres, four shapes of data: time series, relational rows, JSON, vectors. Live counts from the demo service, 2026-10-11.
one person, one id per organization
image + image_type for photos and PDFs
· find the fax that mentions this drug
31,289 facts, one per value, each with its receipt:
document, page, span, quote, or FHIR resource
chunks 2012 to 2027. Shaded: compressed, still queryable.
A visit-window query opens only the overlapping chunk.
refreshed incrementally; feeds the Home chart
129 filled forms: CDASH VS, LB, CM, DM
and the NJ school health record
728 fields, filled by the filler (nearest to the visit)
and checked by the verifier (rules). Each carries JSONB:
carries the receipts and the audit chain head

24 events: world loaded, document read, form filled, field decided, field explained, form signed. Append-only. Each event stores the SHA-256 of the previous event's hash plus its own content; writers are serialized with a Postgres advisory lock.
GET /api/audit/verify recomputes the chain; one edited, deleted, or reordered event breaks every hash after it.
Every fact has an observed date. Hypertable
chunks make the visit-window query cheap and let
facts join with plain SQL and foreign keys.
decisions are JSONB on the field, so the audit
trail and the export carry them whole.
Each document page is embedded next to the rows
it came from. Search runs in the same
Teal badges are TimescaleDB features, purple is pgvector, grey is plain Postgres. Schema: backend/sql/sourced.sql
